semantics.source: Original problem: shift register with four D flops; all sequential logic positive-edge triggered; active-low synchronous reset.
semantics.transition: At each positive clock edge, if resetn is zero clear all four stages; otherwise stage 0 captures in and each subsequent stage captures the previous stage.
semantics.output: out continuously exposes stage 3; input sampled on edge N reaches out on edge N+3 (four sampling edges).
semantics.reset: Reset assertion between rising edges leaves state unchanged; rising edge with resetn=0 clears every stage.
semantics.initialization: No initial value is specified; no RTL initialization is added. Verification establishes known state using a synchronous reset edge.

verification.oracle: Independent history of the most recent four input samples, cleared on active reset edges, derived from original problem.
cases: single-bit impulse and exact four-edge propagation
reset assertion and release between edges
verification.sampling: Check unchanged output before edge and after falling edge; check new output after positive-edge nonblocking updates.
verification.success: No mismatches, explicit PASS line, bounded timeout

specification_ambiguities.issue: Reset value is not explicitly stated.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Interpret reset of D flops as clearing all stages to zero.
Leave RTL uninitialized and impose no defined initial output requirement.
